text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the mall on my day 
off, I spotted a familiar face in front of 
a cosmetics shop.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What do you think of this ring? The color 
and texture aren't bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide. ...That says 'ear cuff' right 
there.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—What!? No matter how you look at it, it's 
clearly a ring, but it's not...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-kun. Apologies, I'm a bit 
disoriented...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"You see, Marvelous-kun asked me to help 
pick out a present for Mayano-kun."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
What do I do, what do I do~~?! The 
Marvelous just isn't bubbling up~~~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Marvelous, did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! Mayano won her race☆ So I 
wanna give you a marvelous present★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Apparently what Mayano really wants is 
"stuff that'll turn her into a mature 
woman"!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
What kind is it? Sweet? Spicy? Hot? Cold!? 
I have no idea at aaall☆ Ahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—And so, we ended up helping pick out a 
present. Including Taishin, who happened 
to be there with us.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
This is what happens when Hayahide sticks 
her nose in... And on top of that, 
Marvelous herself wandered off somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Free-spirited as she is, something else 
probably caught her eye. We can just 
contact her later.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, getting back to the topic at hand— We 
must choose the "goods that make you a 
mature woman" that Mayano-kun desires.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, what even is a "mature woman"...? 
How is that defined? Does it just mean 
age?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As I listened to her talk, I got the 
feeling that she was getting a bit too 
caught up in the idea of being a 'mature 
woman.'"
choice_data_list: Why not try thinking about it more simply?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ho... Keep it simple?
choice_data_list:
You two should just choose whichever one 
you think is best.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's true. If we don't think it's 
good ourselves, there's no way we can get 
that across to others.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Alright. Then Taishin, let's each go pick 
one out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while later, the two returned, 
each carrying their candidate for a 
present.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Biwa Hayahide picked out red 
nail polish, and Narita Taishin chose 
silver earrings.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then as a neutral third party, Trainer, 
I'd like to ask you. Which do you think is 
better: nail polish, or earrings?
choice_data_list: The sultry manicure Hayahide picked out

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hoh, you agree with me?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it reminded me of an outfit from 
a past Christmas party.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I painted my nails to match my outfit back 
then, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's fascinating how just a splash of 
color on your fingertips can completely 
change an impression. I wanted you to 
enjoy that fun too, Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, news to me. I had no idea you 
thought that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin also agreed with the nail 
polish idea, so the present was decided.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano, Happy Marvelous!! Congrats on your 
race victory~~~☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh, a present!? And nail polish at that!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"It makes me look like such a mature 
woman! Overflowing with charm, right?♪ 
Thanks, you three~☆"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it seems to have been a great 
success. All the trouble spent picking it 
out was worth it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, is that so.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I just remembered the Christmas party we 
had before, and the present I gave to 
Hayahide there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Those silver earrings from back then... I 
was just thinking they weren't half bad.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ho, you even paid attention to such fine 
details?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't really that big a deal— 
...Anyway, let's hurry up and pick out the 
present.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide agreed with the earring idea 
as well, and the present was decided.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano, Happy Marvelous!! Congrats on your 
race victory~~~☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh, a present!? And earrings at that!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"It makes me look like such a mature 
woman! Like, super cool and stylish♪ 
Thanks, you three~☆"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, but what kind of outfit would go 
well with these earrings? Maya wants you 
to tell her~☆

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Wait, is this going to keep 
going?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, they really rely on me, don't they? 
As a senior, nothing makes me happier.
